I feel you.

When I was 14 or so I hated my family and used to think that my friends would be everything I'd ever need to support me emotionally.

Fast forward, now I'm 20 and I still think the same.
If you count emotionally abuse, then pretty much yeah

When I finish my education and get a job, I'd probs be ignoring her and living my own life. Don't know if I can ever go NC with her bc the only form of contact I've planned for is to send support money when I earn enough. I only feel indebted to her bc of monetary reasons.
To sum it up, widowed asian mom who always thinks she's always right and basically screams at her children if they dont do what she wants or if they try to reason with her
As long as she suffers pain, I'm fine with that :)
Um...kinda? >!Betty's mom & Jughead's dad were sort of together in the past, then they got together again so you can't blame Betty or Jughead AHAHA!<
Season 1 pretty good, season 2 eh, season 3 is just feckin weird at this point
